name: codius-app
description: Codius: the open-source workspace for local AI coding agents

scripts.dev:server:watch: concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue,cyan "npm run watch:protocol" "npm run watch:client" "npm run dev:server:raw"
scripts.build:client: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace=@codius.ai/client
scripts.build:client:clean: npm run build:protocol:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@codius.ai/client
scripts.build:server-deps: npm run build:highlight && npm run build:relay && npm run build:client
scripts.build:server-deps:clean: npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:relay:clean && npm run build:client:clean
scripts.build:server: npm run build:server-deps && npm run build --workspace=@codius.ai/server && npm run build --workspace=@codius.ai/cli
scripts.build:server:clean: npm run build:server-deps:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@codius.ai/server && npm run build:clean --workspace=@codius.ai/cli
scripts.build:app-deps: npm run build:highlight && npm run build:client && npm run build --workspace=@codius.ai/expo-two-way-audio
scripts.build:app-deps:clean: npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:client:clean && npm run build --workspace=@codius.ai/expo-two-way-audio
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run typecheck --workspace=@codius.ai/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codius.ai/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codius.ai/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codius.ai/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codius.ai/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:app-deps:clean && cd packages/app && cross-env CODIUS_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && npm run build --workspace=@codius.ai/desktop --
scripts.version: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: npm run release:prepare && npm run test:npm-packages && npm run release:packages:pack
scripts.release:beta:patch: npm run version:all:beta:patch && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:minor: npm run version:all:beta:minor && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:major: npm run version:all:beta:major && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:next: npm run version:all:beta:next && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:promote: npm run version:all:promote && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:all:patch && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:all:minor && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: npm run version:all:major && npm run release:check && npm run release:push
